_comment: OpenRouter (default provider). The proxy advertises three models: claude-opus-4-8 -> GLM 5.2, claude-sonnet-5 -> Sonnet 5, claude-fable-5 -> GLM 5.2 :nitro (fastest provider). Requests containing images are escalated to Claude Sonnet 5. skipWebFetchPreflight keeps native WebFetch working behind the local proxy.
